observations.clock_basis: node agent-container finishedAt to API terminal event at; clock skew unqualified

boundaries.pod_terminal_observed_at: first harness receipt of terminal Pod phase; not API-server commit time
boundaries.job_terminal_condition_at: terminal Job condition lastTransitionTime; Job-controller clock
boundaries.job_terminal_observed_at: first harness receipt of terminal Job condition; not API-server commit time
boundaries.job_success_criteria_observed_at: first harness receipt of SuccessCriteriaMet=True; not API-server commit time
boundaries.api_terminal_persisted_at: Agent OS persisted terminal event at; API process clock
boundaries.api_terminal_observed_at: harness load poll returned terminal response; includes sequential polling/order delay

timing_breakdown.attribution: observation boundaries, not isolated component service times

paired_fraction.formula: (first Job-terminal receipt - first Pod-terminal receipt) / (first terminal API response receipt - first Pod-terminal receipt)

analysis.decision: retain_current_runtime_behavior; both measured headroom gates failed
limits: Watch receipts include transport and reader scheduling; sequential API polling adds order/observation delay.
One mixed-clock Pod-receipt to Job-completion interval is negative and remains retained.
No isolated component service times, effective QPS ceiling, EKS behavior or stable tail SLO is established.
